patches_modified.name: Block update prompts
patches_modified.description: Stops Kick from asking for or forcing an app update. A patched Kick can't be updated from Google Play, so update by patching a newer version. On by default. Turn it off in Lurk settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Bypass VOD ad sessions
patches_modified.description: Experimental: uses the original VOD URL instead of requesting a separate ad-session manifest. Does not remove ads stitched into live streams. Enable in Lurk settings after patching.

patches_modified.name: Clean share links
patches_modified.description: Removes known campaign and advertising click parameters from kick.com links in share sheets. Keeps timestamps, clip IDs, unknown parameters and fragments. Kick's current share links are already clean.

patches_modified.name: Clone app
patches_modified.description: Installs Kick under another package name alongside the original, with separate sign-in and settings. Sharing sign-in with Kick's broadcaster app may not work after re-signing.

patches_modified.name: Default startup tab
patches_modified.description: Adds a choice of the screen Kick opens on instead of Home: Browse or Following. Links and notifications still open what they point to. Starts on Home. Choose another in Lurk settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Default video quality
patches_modified.description: Sets the default adaptive quality ceiling to the selected height when that rendition exists. Kick can still choose a lower quality. The player's Auto option uses this ceiling. A lower starting ceiling can be set for mobile data in Lurk settings > Playback; it's off until then.

patches_modified.name: Disable analytics
patches_modified.description: Disables Firebase Analytics collection, Insider and Datadog initialization/events, Mux/Datazoom player analytics and PAL nonce requests. Playback API requests remain necessary to obtain streams. Restart Kick after changing this setting. This does not remove video ads.

patches_modified.name: Disable autoplay
patches_modified.description: Starts Kick's feed previews switched off. Existing preferences and Kick's own autoplay switch keep working. Does not change intentionally opened streams.

patches_modified.name: Don't save searches
patches_modified.description: Stops Kick from saving what you search for on this device. Searches you saved earlier stay until you remove them. On by default. Turn it off in Lurk settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Hide Clips
patches_modified.description: Hides Clips tabs in Browse, channels and categories, and the popular-clips row on channels. Shared clip links still open.

patches_modified.name: Hide Home sections
patches_modified.description: Hides the featured carousel, recommended streams and categories rows on Home, each with its own switch. Starts off. Turn them on in Lurk settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Hide KICKs tipping
patches_modified.description: Hides the chat gift-shop button, KICKs purchase button and leaderboard tipping prompt.

patches_modified.name: Hide chat highlights

patches_modified.name: Hide rating prompt
patches_modified.description: Stops Kick from asking you to rate the app. On by default. Turn it off in Lurk settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Hide subscription upsells
patches_modified.description: Hides channel Subscribe and Gift a Sub buttons and the leaderboard gift-subscription prompt. Keeps the existing subscribed indicator.

patches_modified.name: Lurk icon

patches_modified.name: Normal latency
patches_modified.description: Adds a switch that turns off low-latency mode for live streams: a few seconds more delay, fewer rebuffers on weak connections. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Remove tracking permissions
patches_modified.description: Removes advertising ID, ad attribution and Google Play install-referrer permissions. Other identifiers and analytics require separate controls.

patches_modified.name: Seek interval
patches_modified.description: Sets how far the rewind and forward buttons skip in videos and rewound live streams: 5, 15, 20 or 30 seconds instead of 10. Starts at Kick's 10 seconds. Choose another in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Show deleted messages
patches_modified.description: Keeps chat messages that moderators delete, or remove with a timeout or ban, struck through with a (Deleted), (Timed out) or (Banned) label, the way Kick's chat shows them to moderators, along with its ban, timeout and unban lines. Large KICKs gifts in chat also get the moderators' menu, whose Delete is meant for the channel's moderators. A second switch keeps the chat when a moderator clears it. Both on by default, as on Twitch. Turn them off in Lurk settings > Chat.

patches_modified.name: Sleep timer
patches_modified.description: Pauses playback a chosen time after it last started or resumed, including background audio. Starts off. Choose a time in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Stay on channel when it hosts
patches_modified.description: When the channel you're watching hosts another one, Kick's host dialog waits for you instead of switching when its countdown ends: Watch now still switches, Cancel stays. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Third-party emotes
patches_modified.description: Adds optional 7TV emotes to chat, the native picker and autocomplete, with zero-width layers and live set updates. Sends the channel owner's Kick user ID to 7tv.io, subscribes to set IDs at events.7tv.io and loads images from cdn.7tv.app. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Chat.

patches_modified.name: Block cookie notice
patches_modified.description: Stops Rumble's Ketch consent SDK from loading, so the cookie notice never appears and no consent is recorded, and ignores consent recorded earlier. Rumble then keeps the analytics and ad tracking it gates on consent switched off. After restarting, Airship does not start; this may affect push notifications. Settings > Data Consent no longer opens.
patches_modified.previous_description: Stops Rumble's Ketch consent SDK from loading, so the cookie notice never appears and no consent is recorded, and ignores consent recorded earlier. Rumble then keeps the analytics and ad tracking it gates on consent switched off. Push notifications stop too, since Rumble only starts its push service (Airship) with consent. Settings > Data Consent no longer opens.

patches_modified.name: Anonymous chat
patches_modified.description: Adds a switch that reads chat as an anonymous guest, the way Twitch does when signed out, while the rest of the app stays signed in, so you aren't listed among a channel's chatters. Sending chat messages is disabled while it's on. Off by default; applies after a restart.

patches_modified.name: Auto-claim channel points
patches_modified.description: Adds a switch that claims the channel points bonus for your account as soon as its chest appears in a channel's chat, with the same request as tapping the chest. Each bonus is claimed once. Off by default; needs a signed-in account.

patches_modified.name: Avoid stitched ads
patches_modified.description: While Twitch's server stitches an ad break into a live stream, plays the stream instead from a picture-by-picture session, the kind Twitch itself shows during breaks, which gets no ads: at 360p at most, with sound, then back to the stream's own session and quality when the break is over. The player doesn't reload. The playback token for that session is requested without your account. When none can be had, the break plays, and Mute stitched ads still mutes and covers it. Native and React Native players; streams started while it's off are left alone.

patches_modified.name: Background audio
patches_modified.description: Keeps streams and videos playing as audio when you leave the app, using Twitch's own "Continue Playing Audio in the Background" with its audio-only stream and media notification. Changes only the default, Never in Twitch: a choice made in Twitch's settings still wins.

patches_modified.name: Block client ads
patches_modified.description: Declines ads handled by Twitch's native client ad eligibility check using its existing not eligible result. Does not remove ads stitched into streams by the server or guarantee ad-free playback.

patches_modified.name: Block cookie notice

patches_modified.name: Disable autoplay

patches_modified.name: Force ExoPlayer

patches_modified.name: Hide Bits tipping
patches_modified.description: Hides chat Bits buttons, Bits purchase cards, the cheering tray and one-tap Bits controls. Keeps normal chat and Bits messages sent by other viewers.

patches_modified.name: Hide Clips
patches_modified.description: Hides the Clips discovery tab on Home and the Clips tab on native channel profiles. Shared clip links still open.

patches_modified.name: Hide Home sections
patches_modified.description: Hides Stories on Home and, each with its own switch, the Continue watching, offline channels and recommended channels sections of Following.

patches_modified.name: Hide chat highlights
patches_modified.description: Hides the Hype Train, Bits and gift leaderboards, other viewers' sub and gift messages and gift banners, pinned cheers and watch-streak pop-ups, each with its own switch. Celebrations can be hidden too. Other chat messages are unchanged.

patches_modified.name: Hide mature content warning
patches_modified.description: Skips the content warning on streams, videos and clips with mature content labels, as if you had chosen Start Watching. Age, region, guardian and account restrictions still apply. Off by default.

patches_modified.name: Hide player buttons
patches_modified.description: Hides the player's Clip, Cast and Share buttons, each with its own switch. Cast stays visible by default. Other ways to clip and share, such as the channel page, are unchanged.

patches_modified.name: Hide subscription upsells
patches_modified.description: Hides Subscribe and Gift a Sub prompts, Turbo promotions and the native Turbo signup/startup offer. Keeps the existing subscribed indicator and legitimate account entitlements.

patches_modified.name: Lurk icon
patches_modified.description: Replaces Twitch's launcher icon with Lurk artwork, including Android's themed icon.

patches_modified.name: Mute stitched ads
patches_modified.description: While an ad break that Twitch's server stitched into a stream plays, mutes the player and covers the video with black, then restores both when the stream returns. Works in the native and React Native players. The ad still plays and the break isn't shorter.

patches_modified.name: Navigation bar position
patches_modified.description: Adds a choice that moves Twitch's bottom navigation bar to the top of the screen and/or hides its labels, leaving only the icons. Twitch's own layout stays until another choice is made in Lurk settings.

patches_modified.name: Normal latency
patches_modified.description: Adds a setting that turns off the player's low-latency mode for live streams: a few seconds more delay to the broadcaster, for fewer rebuffers on a weak connection. Off until turned on in Lurk settings.

patches_modified.name: Player gestures
patches_modified.description: Sets the skip interval of the video (VOD) rewind and forward buttons and the media notification, and adds brightness (left) and volume (right) swipes on the video in landscape. Twitch's -10/+30 seconds stay until you choose another interval in Lurk settings; swipes start off.

patches_modified.name: Playlist proxy
patches_modified.description: Sends live stream playlist requests to a proxy server you set in this patch's options, for example one that returns playlists without stitched ads. The proxy receives each request in full, including your signed playback token, which identifies your account: only use a proxy you trust. An http:// proxy gets an exception from Twitch's HTTPS-only rule for its host alone, and the token then travels unencrypted. Does nothing while the proxy URL is empty. Videos and clips are not proxied.

patches_modified.name: Refresh stream
patches_modified.description: Long-press the player's settings gear, or the middle of the video, to reload a stuck stream through Twitch's own Retry: a new access token and playlist for live streams, the same position for videos. Covers Twitch's native players.

patches_modified.name: Remove tracking permissions
patches_modified.description: Removes advertising ID and Google Play install-referrer permissions. Other identifiers and analytics require separate controls.

patches_modified.name: Show deleted messages
patches_modified.description: Keeps the text of chat messages that moderators delete, or remove with a timeout or ban, struck through and dimmed instead of Twitch's "message deleted" placeholder. A second switch keeps the messages when a moderator clears the whole chat.

patches_modified.name: Show video stats
patches_modified.description: Adds the video stats button Twitch shows only to its staff to the native player: latency to the broadcaster, bitrate, buffer, dropped frames, codecs and server. Everything shown is local to the player.

patches_modified.name: Sleep timer
patches_modified.description: Pauses playback a chosen time after it last started or resumed, through Twitch's own pause for native, portal and React Native players, and says so in a short notice. Choose the time in Lurk settings; it is off until then.

patches_modified.name: Tablet layout
patches_modified.description: Adds a switch that makes Twitch treat the phone as a tablet: Home and the player rotate, the player shows chat beside the video in landscape, and a navigation rail on the left replaces the bottom bar in landscape (and in portrait too with a second switch). Off until turned on in Lurk settings; applies after a restart.

patches_modified.name: Third-party badges

The badge switches download that service's public list of all badge holders (api.frankerfacez.com, api.chatterino.com) about once an hour and check it on the phone. The pronouns switch sends the username of each chatter whose message you see to pronouns.alejo.io. 7TV badges are not included.

patches_modified.name: Hide player flyout menu components
patches_modified.description: Adds options to hide menu components that appear when pressing the gear icon in the video player.

patches_modified.name: Hide player overlay buttons
patches_modified.description: Adds options to hide the player Cast, Autoplay, Captions, Previous & Next buttons, and to hide or change the opacity of the player control buttons background.

patches_modified.name: Hide related video overlay
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to hide the related video overlay shown when swiping up in fullscreen.

patches_modified.name: Hide related videos
patches_modified.description: Adds options to hide related videos.

patches_modified.name: Hide status bar
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to hide the system status bar. Swipe down from the top edge to show it for a moment.

patches_modified.name: Hide timestamp
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to hide the timestamp in the bottom left of the video player.

patches_modified.name: Hide video action buttons
patches_modified.description: Adds options to hide video action buttons in fullscreen and portrait modes.

patches_modified.name: Loop video
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to loop videos and display loop video button in the video player.

patches_modified.name: Media notification controls
patches_modified.description: Adds options to disable the seekbar and previous/next buttons in the media notification and headphone controls.

patches_modified.name: Miniplayer
patches_modified.description: Adds options to change the in-app minimized player. Patching 21.28.206 and lower has more miniplayer types to choose from.

patches_modified.name: Mute button
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to show a player button that mutes the video audio.

patches_modified.name: Navigation bar
patches_modified.description: Adds options to hide and change the bottom navigation bar (such as the Shorts button) and the upper navigation toolbar.

patches_modified.name: Network proxy
patches_modified.description: Adds settings to route supported network requests through an HTTP or HTTPS proxy. Including this patch may cause connectivity problems on certain devices

patches_modified.name: Open Shorts in regular player
patches_modified.description: Adds options to open Shorts in the regular video player.

patches_modified.name: Open channel of live avatar
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to prevent a channel's current live video from opening when tapping its avatar.

patches_modified.name: Open links externally
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to always open links in your browser instead of with the in-app browser.

patches_modified.name: Open system share sheet
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to always open the system share sheet instead of the in-app share sheet.

patches_modified.name: Open videos fullscreen
patches_modified.description: Adds options to automatically open videos in fullscreen portrait or landscape mode.

patches_modified.name: Override YouTube Music buttons
patches_modified.description: Overrides YouTube Music buttons to open Morphe Music or any compatible third-party client.

patches_modified.name: Picture-in-picture button
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to display a picture-in-picture button in the video player.

patches_modified.name: Play all
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to play all the videos from a channel and to display play all button in the video player.

patches_modified.name: Playback buffer
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to change the video playback buffer size.

patches_modified.name: Playback in feeds
patches_modified.description: Adds the 'Playback in feeds' setting of YouTube to the Morphe settings, where it is always available even if YouTube hides it.

patches_modified.name: Playback speed
patches_modified.description: Adds options to customize available playback speeds, set a default playback speed, and show a speed dialog button in the video player.

patches_modified.name: Player icon style
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to change the style of the player button icons.

patches_modified.name: PoToken provider
patches_modified.description: Adds option to get PoToken using an external PoToken minter app.

patches_modified.name: Reload video
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to display reload video button in the video player.

patches_modified.name: Remember live stream playback position
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to remember the playback position of an ongoing live stream and resume from there when reopening that live stream.

patches_modified.name: Remove background playback restrictions
patches_modified.description: Removes restrictions on background playback, including playing kids videos in the background.

patches_modified.name: Remove viewer discretion dialog
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to remove the dialog that appears when opening a video that has been age-restricted by accepting it automatically. This does not bypass the age restriction.

patches_modified.name: Restore original titles
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to show the original video titles, video descriptions and channel descriptions instead of the auto-translated ones.

patches_modified.name: Return YouTube Dislike
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to show the dislike count of videos with Return YouTube Dislike, and the like count and like ratio on the thumbnails of feed videos.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds an option to show the dislike count of videos with Return YouTube Dislike.

patches_modified.name: Sanitize sharing links
patches_modified.description: Removes the tracking query parameters from shared links.

patches_modified.name: Save to Watch later
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to display save to Watch later button in the video player.

patches_modified.name: Seekbar
patches_modified.description: Adds options to show old seekbar thumbnails, disable precise seeking when swiping up on the seekbar, slide to seek instead of playing at 2x speed when pressing and holding, tapping the player seekbar to seek, hiding the video player seekbar, enabling seeking in live streams, and expanding the live stream DVR duration.

patches_modified.name: Settings menu filter
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to hide items on the standard YouTube settings screen by their visible name.

patches_modified.name: Shorts autoplay
patches_modified.description: Adds options to automatically play the next Short.

patches_modified.name: Shorts icon style
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to change the style of the Shorts action button icons.

patches_modified.name: Skip silence
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to automatically skip silent pauses in audio playback.

patches_modified.name: SponsorBlock
patches_modified.description: Adds options to enable and configure SponsorBlock, which can skip undesired video segments such as sponsored content.

patches_modified.name: Spoof app version
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to trick the app into thinking you are running an older version.

patches_modified.name: Spoof device dimensions
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to spoof the device dimensions which can unlock higher video qualities.

patches_modified.name: Spoof video streams
patches_modified.description: Adds options to spoof the client video streams to fix playback.

patches_modified.name: Swipe controls
patches_modified.description: Adds options to enable and configure volume and brightness swipe controls.

patches_modified.name: Theme
patches_modified.description: Adds options for theming, and settings to change the app foreground and background colors.

patches_modified.name: Video quality
patches_modified.description: Adds options to set default video qualities and always use the advanced video quality menu.

patches_modified.name: Voice over translation
patches_modified.description: Adds additional voice over languages using text-to-speech synchronized to the video playback.

patches_modified.name: Wide search bar
patches_modified.description: Adds a wide search bar to the top of the home and subscription feed.

patches_added.name: Copy text
patches_added.description: Adds an option to make post and comment text selectable and copyable. Disables collapsing comments. This patch works with Reddit 2026.24.0 and newer.

patches_added.name: Customize post layout
patches_added.description: Adds options to show the view count of posts, to move the vote and comment buttons of posts to the right side, and to swap the vote and comment buttons. Moving and swapping the buttons works with Reddit 2026.39.0 and newer.

patches_added.name: Download location
patches_added.description: Adds options to choose the folder and file name of downloaded images and videos, which can use the subreddit, author and account, and can be set per account.

patches_added.name: Feed media max height
patches_added.description: Adds an option to change the maximum height of images, videos and galleries in the feed.

patches_added.name: Full width feed media
patches_added.description: Adds an option to show images and videos edge to edge in the feed and post details, without side padding and rounded corners.

patches_added.name: Hide media viewer components
patches_added.description: Adds options to hide the "See the conversation" button and the title, buttons and video controls of the media viewer. Hiding the title, buttons and video controls requires Reddit 2026.38.0 or newer.

patches_added.name: Keep feed position
patches_added.description: Adds an option to keep the feed at the same position after closing a post, image or video, instead of moving the opened post to the top of the screen.

patches_added.name: Media viewer black background
patches_added.description: Adds an option to use a black background behind images and videos in the media viewer, instead of the theme background color.

patches_added.name: Media viewer fade
patches_added.description: Adds an option to lower or remove the dark fade behind the caption when viewing images and videos.

patches_added.name: Redgifs audio
patches_added.description: Adds an option to play the original Redgifs video, which has audio, instead of Reddit's silent copy.

patches_added.name: Remember collapsed comments
patches_added.description: Adds an option to keep comments you collapsed collapsed when reopening a post.

patches_added.name: Show flairs in home feed
patches_added.description: Adds an option to show post flair badges in the home feed. This patch works with Reddit 2026.24.0 and newer.

patches_removed.name: Show view count
patches_removed.description: Adds an option to show the view count of Posts.

patches_modified.name: App icon
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to select from the Reddit app icons available in the manifest.

patches_modified.name: Custom branding name for Reddit
patches_modified.description: Changes the Reddit app name to the name specified in patch options.

patches_modified.name: Custom font
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to replace Reddit Sans / Roboto with a custom TTF or OTF font file at runtime.

patches_modified.name: Disable modern home
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to disable the modern home UI. This patch works with Reddit 2026.24.0 and earlier.

patches_modified.name: Disable screenshot popup
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to disable the popup that appears when taking a screenshot.

patches_modified.name: Force system font
patches_modified.description: Adds an option that renders Reddit with the device system font instead of Reddit Sans / Roboto.

patches_modified.name: Hide Ask button
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to hide Ask button in the search bar.

patches_modified.name: Hide Reddit search
patches_modified.description: Permanently hides the Reddit search in the contextual menu. This patch does not work with root mounting

patches_modified.name: Hide Trending shelves
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to hide the Trending shelves from feed and search suggestions.

patches_modified.name: Hide ads
patches_modified.description: Adds options to hide ads.

patches_modified.name: Hide communities shelf
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to hide the related or suggested communities shelf in subreddits.

patches_modified.name: Hide navigation buttons
patches_modified.description: Adds options to hide buttons in the navigation bar.

patches_modified.name: Hide sidebar components
patches_modified.description: Adds options to hide the sidebar components.

patches_modified.name: Open links directly
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to skip over redirection URLs in external links.

patches_modified.name: Open links externally
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to always open links in your browser instead of with the in-app-browser.

patches_modified.name: Remove subreddit dialog
patches_modified.description: Adds options to remove the NSFW community warning and notifications suggestion dialogs by dismissing them automatically.

patches_modified.name: Sanitize sharing links
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to sanitize sharing links by removing tracking query parameters.

patches_modified.name: Spoof signature
patches_modified.description: Spoofs the signature of the app to fix notification issues.

patches_modified.name: Start as guest
patches_modified.description: Skips the forced startup login screen using Reddit's native guest browsing mode.

patches_modified.name: Remove Ozon ads
patches_modified.description: Removes Ozon ad widgets, banner carousels, video ads, and PDP promo blocks.

patches_modified.name: Remove Ozon ads
patches_modified.description: Removes Ozon ad widgets, banner carousels, video ads, and PDP promo blocks.

patches_modified.name: Override YouTube Music buttons
patches_modified.description: Overrides YouTube Music buttons to open any compatible third-party client.
patches_modified.previous_description: Overrides YouTube Music buttons to open TADa Music or any compatible third-party client.

patches_added.name: Background daily check-in worker
patches_added.description: Runs the Simosa daily check-in from a 24-hour WorkManager job that this patch adds to the app, with two-tier token auth, stale-token retry, a per-account day latch and a status notification.

patches_added.name: Chat only
patches_added.description: Turns Instagram into a chat-only messenger: opens Direct instead of the feed and removes the home feed, Reels, Explore, Stories, ads and suggestions. Long-press the Direct title (or the Profile tab) to open the Feurstagram settings.

patches_removed.name: Feed item filtering
patches_removed.description: Drops ad/promo and suggested feed units at the JSON-parse layer, catching the ones injected inline into the timeline that URL blocking misses. Gated on the Ads and Suggested toggles.

patches_removed.name: Force SDR display
patches_removed.description: Reroutes Instagram's window colour-mode changes so the app can be pinned to SDR, keeping the dark UI's blacks deep instead of the washed-out look HDR forces.

patches_removed.name: Install-packages permission
patches_removed.description: Declares REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES so the update dialog can download and install a new release directly instead of opening the browser.

patches_removed.name: Limit feed to following profiles
patches_removed.description: Optionally restricts the home feed to accounts you follow, by rewriting the feed request's pagination header. Gated on the runtime toggle.

patches_removed.name: Network content blocking
patches_removed.description: Blocks the feed, stories, explore, reels, ads, suggestions and tracking at the network layer, gated on the runtime toggles.

patches_removed.name: Popup hiding
patches_removed.description: Drops Instagram's popups ("Couldn't refresh feed"), which a blocked surface raises on every failed request. Gated on the Instagram popups toggle.

patches_removed.name: Restart relay
patches_removed.description: Declares the one-shot activity Feurstagram runs in its own process to bring Instagram back after the cache-clear restart.

patches_removed.name: Settings entry point
patches_removed.description: Opens the Feurstagram settings on a long-press of the Home tab, and installs the surface hiders and update check.

patches_removed.name: Signature check bypass
patches_removed.description: Forces Instagram's signing-certificate trust checks to always pass, so a re-signed APK is treated as an official Meta build and deep links route to their content instead of falling back to the home feed.

patches_modified.name: Unlock premium
patches_modified.description: Unlocks all AI Plant Doctor premium features by bypassing Google Play Billing and returning an active annual subscription.
